beats.say: Timothée Chalamet returns as Paul Atreides in the Dune Part Three trailer.
The new footage reveals him facing a dangerous insurgency and visions of absolute chaos across Arrakis.
Director Denis Villeneuve brought this story to screen from a script written alongside Brian K. Vaughan.
Principal photography kicked off in July 2025 across Hungary and the United Arab Emirates, wrapping completely by November.
That means the production wrapped thirteen full months before its United States release date on Friday 18 December 2026.
All of that careful planning sets up a massive cinematic clash for the throne.
That was Dune: Part Three; subscribe so you do not miss the next breakdown. Will Paul survive the uprising?
